landing.hero_subtitle: NPS Saathi simplifies National Pension System for every Indian citizen. Understand your pension, plan your future.
landing.feature_1_desc: We explain NPS in simple language that everyone can understand.
landing.feature_2_desc: Ask questions about your pension and get instant, clear answers.
landing.feature_3_desc: Speak your queries in your language. We understand Hindi, Tamil, and more.
landing.feature_4_desc: See how much pension you will receive based on your contributions.
landing.nps_explanation: The National Pension System (NPS) is a voluntary retirement savings scheme designed to enable systematic savings during your working life. It is regulated by PFRDA (Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority).
